original.statement: Upgrading to Karpenter 1.0.0+ introduces v1 APIs and requires following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure; stored v1beta1 manifests must be migrated to v1 before v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0.

decision.reason: [ev-bfb089d90d84] tells operators not to upgrade to 1.0.0+ without following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure. That puts every environment upgrading from a version below 1.0.0 in scope, so edge-from-version in-range "<1.0.0" matches the exposed state. P3's gvk-in-use v1beta1 condition only covers the follow-on step of migrating stored manifests. It would miss pre-1.0 environments that must still follow the upgrade procedure, so it is narrower than the stated exposure.
